2026_05_DEN_LAC.headline: Payton reclaims the calls as Herbert tests Denver’s depleted corners
2026_05_DEN_LAC.paragraph1: Sean Payton resumes Denver’s play-calling with Bo Nix facing a Chargers secondary missing Derwin James Jr. and Donte Jackson. The Broncos can attack replacement defenders with intermediate routes, but Los Angeles can counter with pressure and force Nix to reset after the snap. Justin Herbert, meanwhile, faces Nik Bonitto without starting tackles Rashawn Slater and Joe Alt; quick passes behind rookie Travis Burke could limit sacks. Denver’s own missing corners Pat Surtain II and Riley Moss give Herbert an opportunity if his protection holds.
2026_05_DEN_LAC.model_rationale: Denver's pressure can test an inexperienced Los Angeles tackle, while Herbert can attack the Broncos' replacement cornerbacks. Payton's play-calling decisions provide another way to change the matchup.
